global: This tonkotsu ramen boasts a rich, creamy broth with tender chashu pork and naruto fish cake nestled atop. Served in a blue-patterned bowl, it’s garnished with green onions and a red spice dot, set on a wooden table under warm, inviting light.

regions.background: Wooden table surface shows warm brown tones, visible grain patterns, and subtle texture under soft lighting.
regions.bowl: White ceramic ramen bowl with blue geometric patterned rim, smooth surface, circular shape, slight glaze sheen.
regions.soup: The tonkotsu (pork bone) broth is creamy yellow, thick, and glossy, swirling around noodles and garnishes.
regions.meat: Chashu pork: tender, pale brown slices with green herb specks, slightly curled edges, and soft, moist texture.
regions.naruto: Naruto fish cake: round, pale pink center with white edges, speckled green herbs, smooth surface.
